clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, the Crate of Inn Supplies waits for a journey to Kharanos. Troggs have cut off the mountain pass, so the Thunderbrew Distillery depends on travelers to carry its goods.

The Crate of Inn Supplies is waiting near Anvilmar for a safe way through Coldridge Pass. Troggs have cut off the route, stopping civilian couriers until Mountaineers can clear the road. Hands Springsprocket packed the crate with tavern provisions for Tannok Frosthammer in Kharanos, where the supplies are needed.
